answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake of 500 tokens plus a hardware credential, logged at a registration wharf, before it can transact. A detected sybil forfeits the full bond, gets slashed 100 percent, and waits 30 epochs before re-registration is allowed. Copying one credential across N identities costs N bonds plus a shared penalty, so independent jurors can flag duplicates, weigh each claim by its marble, and burn the lantern of fake reputation.
